name: Documentation Improvement
about: Propose changes or additions to the guides, architectural charts, or installation guidelines.
title: "[DOCS]: "
labels: ["documentation"]
assignees: ""
---

### 📝 Area of Documentation
State which file or guide requires improvement (e.g., `README.md`, `SETUP.md`, API descriptions, inline docs).

### 💡 Description of the Enhancement
Explain what information is missing, unclear, or out-of-date, and how this update improves the onboarding or maintenance experience.

### 🎯 Proposed Solutions
Provide an outline of the documentation structures, paragraphs, or charts you intend to integrate.

### 📌 Additional Information
Provide links to related resources, external API specifications, or configuration files that clarify the requested update.
